hypothesis: Y040 exact physical-equivalence required the complete current affine coordinate law. In a new family of time-varying affine frames mod16, observing known canonical cell0 and cell1 positions yields enough information to recover a,b and hence reference physical allocation without the full law; one landmark is insufficient to identify odd multiplier a. The two-anchor advantage costs two external metadata readings each episode.
freeze: Freeze four new odd affine families with distinct seed/episode offsets, current-episode anchor observation availability, no access to hidden allocations/future outcomes, fixed policies, untouched seeds and criteria before first use. No retuning on sealed first use.
topology: Exact original Y039 source ring: 16 cells and motifs, 7 physical active keys, <=9 inactive persistent cache records, 8 episodes, independent Hall=7, identical read/write policy and FIFO eviction. All arms preserve exactly nine maximum cache entries and store one scalar coordinate per entry.
arms: reference_numeric: canonical graph/matching and canonical cache; 0 anchor observations
moving_raw_numeric: only observed cell IDs, cache stores alias verbatim; 0 anchor observations
one_landmark: read observed position of known canonical cell0 each episode, assume fixed a=1, transform and cache; 1 anchor observation/episode

two_landmark: read observed positions of known canonical cell0 and cell1 each episode, derive b=anchor0 and odd a=(anchor1-anchor0) mod16, invert current frame and cache canonical coordinates; 2 anchor observations/episode
outcome: TWO_LANDMARK_IDENTIFIABILITY iff two_landmark matches reference physical assignment on every heldout seed/episode/family/policy, one_landmark and moving_raw_numeric each have nonzero mismatch, independent Hall7 and write/occupancy parity hold, and no candidate arm uses any true physical assignment for routing. PARTIAL iff two_landmark improves over both one/raw but not exact; NO_TRANSFER otherwise. Preserve churn and every per-seed outcome.
controls: Landmarks are disclosed additional current-coordinate observations, not a learned sensor or free oracle; cost is explicitly tracked as 0/1/2 per episode
No future state, labels, privileged physics, evaluator canonical readout or full coordinate law enters candidate matching
Same seven active/nine cached state and matching calls recorded; all comparisons use frozen topology and policies
One original first-use evidence artifact followed by full pytest; no production rights, first-use retries or accepted-ref mutation
